name: Platonic Solid Voxelization
definition: A method to generate a 3D voxel array representing the interior of regular platonic solids (tetrahedron, cube, octahedron, dodecahedron, icosahedron). It outputs a 3D array where voxel value is 1 if inside the polyhedron and 0 otherwise.
summary: Platonic Solid Voxelization generates a binary 3D array for regular polyhedra using direct half-space intersection tests, unlike methods relying on remeshing.
